changelog:
- Configuration now exclusively uses the persistent file `~/.openclaw/.env`; all `AI_GATEWAY_*` environment variables are ignored.
- The API key must be set in the env file (or temporarily on command line); OpenClaw clients write this automatically.
- Clarified configuration and security notes, including file permission advice.
- Updated description to reflect the new configuration and credential requirements.
- Removed fallback and environment variable reading to ensure users always read latest persistent settings.
summary: Closeli Device Event Query API. Supports natural language queries for device events and returns an AI summary and event list, including event types, time ran...
